Extract posterior quantile samples from MCMC results

Source: R/full_local_regional.r
get.quantile.samples.Rd

Computes GEV quantiles across all MCMC posterior parameter samples for a given probability.

Usage

get.quantile.samples(p, analysis)

Arguments

p

Numeric probability value.

analysis

A result list returned by perform.analysis().

Value

Numeric vector of quantile samples corresponding to each MCMC iteration.
